reasons: Section 1 expressly states that nothing creates an exclusive arrangement and that Customer (The Associated Press) remains free to offer Inventory via other agents or sell to third parties — squarely the preferred position of no exclusivity binding Customer.

No requirements/sole-supplier or non-compete language is cited anywhere; the other 'exclusive' hits identified (non-exclusive license to Customer, exclusive jurisdiction/venue, ownership of marks) are outside the rule's scope and not deviations.
Consistent with a compliant claim, the redline is unchanged and no counterparty comment is proposed; the deterministic check confirms no residual sole-supplier obligation.
